pages.title: A table by the window · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Thursday afternoon in a cozy house in Chicago. Leo wants to celebrate his sister’s birthday. He looks for a nice place for six people. He finds an Italian restaurant online. He picks up the phone and calls. A warm voice answers on the third ring.
“Good afternoon, Casa Bella. How can I help you?” says Gina. “Hello. I’d like to book a table for six people.” says Leo. “Of course. What day would you like?” says Gina.
